# Data dictionary (generated by `python -m harness.export_data`)

All data is synthetic. Values come from the generators below with fixed seeds.

## ap_invoices (uc01: Commercial invoice reconciliation and settlement)

400 rows, seed 1; reference profile 1,000 rows. Files: `ap_invoices.csv`, `ap_invoices__ref_baseline.csv`

| Column | Type | Criticality | Contract rule | Generated as |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| invoice_id | string | 3 | pattern ^INV-\d{6}$ | sequence INV-000000+ |
| vendor_id | string | 3 | pattern ^V-\d{3}$ | one of 8 values |
| account_id | string | 3 | pattern ^ACC-\d{4}$ | derived from vendor_id (fixed mapping) |
| amount | number | 3 | min 0, max 50000 | lognormal(mu 8.3, sigma 0.5), clipped [50, 45000] |
| discount_pct | number | 2 | min 0, max 10 | normal(mean 2.0, sd 0.5), clipped [0, 8] |
| currency | string | 2 | allowed ['AUD'] | constant 'AUD' |
| status | string | 2 | allowed ['open', 'paid'] | one of open, paid |
| vendor_notes | string | 1 |  | one of Net 30., PO attached., Partial shipment., Thanks for your business. |

## contractor_invoices (uc02: Disaster-recovery contractor payments)

300 rows, seed 2; reference profile 1,000 rows. Files: `contractor_invoices.csv`, `contractor_invoices__ref_baseline.csv`, `contractor_invoices__ref_stress.csv`

| Column | Type | Criticality | Contract rule | Generated as |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| invoice_id | string | 3 | pattern ^CI-\d{6}$ | sequence CI-000000+ |
| contractor_id | string | 3 | pattern ^C-\d{2}$ | one of C-01, C-02, C-03, C-04, C-05 |
| account_id | string | 3 | pattern ^ACC-\d{4}$ | derived from contractor_id (fixed mapping) |
| amount | number | 3 | min 0, max 50000 | normal(mean 4000, sd 1200), clipped [200, 20000] |
| crew_size | number | 2 | min 1, max 40 | normal(mean 4, sd 1), clipped [1, 10] |
| job_code | string | 2 | pattern ^J\d{3}$ | one of 10 values |
| status | string | 2 | allowed ['open'] | constant 'open' |
| amount (stress profile) | | | | normal(mean 12000, sd 3500), clipped [500, 45000] |
| crew_size (stress profile) | | | | normal(mean 9, sd 2), clipped [2, 30] |

## lab_results (uc03: Clinical decision support and dosing recommendations)

400 rows, seed 3; reference profile 1,000 rows. Files: `lab_results.csv`, `lab_results__ref_baseline.csv`

| Column | Type | Criticality | Contract rule | Generated as |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| patient_id | string | 3 | pattern ^P-\d{6}$ | sequence P-000000+ |
| creatinine | number | 3 | min 0.2, max 15 | normal(mean 1.0, sd 0.25), clipped [0.3, 4] |
| creatinine_unit | string | 3 | allowed ['mg/dL'] | constant 'mg/dL' |
| egfr | number | 3 | min 5, max 150 | normal(mean 85, sd 15), clipped [10, 140] |
| potassium | number | 3 | min 2, max 7.5 | normal(mean 4.2, sd 0.4), clipped [2.8, 6.5] |
| weight_kg | number | 2 | min 30, max 250 | normal(mean 78, sd 14), clipped [40, 180] |
| ward | string | 1 |  | one of ONC-1, ONC-2, ONC-3 |
| notes | string | 1 |  | constant 'routine', null with probability 0.6 |

## fx_ticks (uc04: Treasury liquidity and cross-border FX)

500 rows, seed 4; reference profile 1,000 rows. Files: `fx_ticks.csv`, `fx_ticks__ref_baseline.csv`

| Column | Type | Criticality | Contract rule | Generated as |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| tick_id | string | 3 | pattern ^T-\d{7}$ | sequence T-0000000+ |
| pair | string | 3 | allowed ['AUDUSD', 'AUDEUR', 'AUDJPY'] | constant 'AUDUSD' |
| rate | number | 3 | min 0.0001, max 500 | normal(mean 0.66, sd 0.004) |
| spread | number | 2 | min 0, max 0.01 | normal(mean 0.0002, sd 5e-05), clipped [1e-05, 0.001] |
| volume | number | 1 | min 0 | lognormal(mu 13, sigma 1) |

300 rows, seed 5; reference profile 1,000 rows. Files: `vendor_bids.csv`, `vendor_bids__ref_baseline.csv`

| Column | Type | Criticality | Contract rule | Generated as |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| bid_id | string | 3 | pattern ^B-\d{5}$ | sequence B-00000+ |
| part_number | string | 3 | pattern ^TF-\d{4}-[A-Z]$ | one of TF-1001-A, TF-1002-B, TF-2040-C, TF-3300-D |
